katie (eng-platform): Quick sync — RCA INC-847 action list is live. Can owners please pledge and confirm due dates? I’ll compile the ownership snapshot for PM/exec. Doc: https://redwood.internal/rca/INC-847

devon (eng-sre): I’ll own ‘DB index rollback + confirm schema revert’ — ETA Fri 2026-04-03 EOD. @ryan_p can you co-own the canary plan?

ryan_p (oncall): Yep, I can co-own canary. Scheduling a 30m dry-run Thu 09:30 PT and will add calendar invite.

ashley (product): For ‘customer comms’ can we move to Mon 2026-04-06? Legal needs a quick review first. @katie ok?

katie (eng-platform): OK to Mon 2026-04-06 for comms — noted. I updated the sheet. Also need someone to take ‘metrics alert thresholds’ validation — @mike?

mike (eng): I’ll take it but need eng-infra help to validate in staging. ETA Mon 2026-04-06 AM. I’ll raise infra ticket.

devon (eng-sre): Heads-up: DB rollback requires a revert script for the migration. I’ll drop the snippet in the doc 
```sh
-- revert the problematic migration
psql -d prod_db -f revert_migration_202603.sql
```
I’ll coordinate with @ryan_p before running.

sre-bot: Incident bot: Runbook updated -> https://infra.redwood/runbooks/INC-847 (update at 3352109900)

katie (eng-platform): Thanks. Plan: I’ll do a reconciliation Friday 16:00 PT and publish the ownership snapshot. If anything changes before then, please ping here. :thumbsup:

ryan_p (oncall): Ack. Also adding a +7 day post-fix follow-up check — I’ll own that and verify alerts are stable.

ashley (product): PM acked. I’ll draft the customer message Mon AM and drop for review here.

mike (eng): INF ticket created: INF-129 — validating alert thresholds in staging. Tagging infra: @devops-anna for config review.

devops-anna: On it — I’ll validate thresholds Wed afternoon. Looks like a small config toggle in promql.

katie (eng-platform): Final ask: if your ETA slips >24h, drop a short update here so I can mark it at-risk in the tracker.

katie (eng-platform): Action summary (compiled):
- devon: DB index rollback + migration revert — ETA 2026-04-03 EOD
- ryan_p: Canary plan + dry-run (Thu 09:30 PT) + +7d post-check — owner
- ashley: Customer comms draft — ETA 2026-04-06 AM
- mike: Metrics alert thresholds validation — ETA 2026-04-06 AM (INF-129)
- devops-anna: Infra validation for thresholds — Wed afternoon

katie (eng-platform): I’ll publish this snapshot at Fri 16:00 PT unless I see updates here. Thanks everyone!
